verdict.rationale: Blink documents a set of local commands running in the app: cat, grep, wc, ls, cp, mv, mkdir, df, du and others (blink-shell-docs-4, docs-35). It also ships a local curl for http/https/scp/sftp transfers (gh-5, gh-7), and commands can be run individually or scripted with redirection (gh-8). Missing for 10: no evidence of tar, no pipe support (gh-8 says there is redirection but no pipe), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the local command set.
